va-58-1-339-8.name: Code of Virginia 58.1-339.8, income tax credit for low-income taxpayers

brackets.note: Set in statute, not indexed, and the same for every filing status. Tax Foundation and PolicyEngine agree.

earnedIncomeCredit.note: A refundable credit "equal to 20 percent" of the federal credit for 2025 and 2026, extended through 2029 by the 2026 Appropriation Act. The nonrefundable option is also 20%, so a resident always does at least as well with the refundable one. It cannot be combined with the $300 per person credit for incomes under the poverty line, and it is lost by filers who take the age deduction or the 65-or-blind exemption, neither of which is checked.
earnedIncomeCredit.name: Virginia earned income tax credit

standardDeduction.note: The statute sets $8,750 for single individuals and $17,500 for married persons for taxable years 2025 and 2026. There is no separate head of household amount, so head of household uses the single amount. It rises to $9,200 / $18,400 for 2027 and $9,300 / $18,600 for 2028 and 2029. Tax Foundation agrees.

personalExemption.note: $930 for each personal exemption (filer, spouse and each dependent). Not indexed. Tax Foundation agrees.

rules.note: No local income taxes per Tax Foundation footnote (a), which does not list Virginia. The $800 aged or blind exemption is from 58.1-322.03(2)(b). Contribution flags checked on 2026-11-12 against PolicyEngine US 2.118.6 (oracle/flags.py), which moves this state's tax by the same amount as this engine for 401k, HSA, IRA and health premium contributions. FSA and commuter benefits are not PolicyEngine inputs and rest on the state starting from federal income. Not read in the state's own instructions. No employee payroll contribution: the US Department of Labor's comparison lists worker unemployment contributions only in Alaska, New Jersey and Pennsylvania and disability insurance only in California, Hawaii, New Jersey, New York and Rhode Island, and no paid leave or similar program with an employee contribution was found for this state on 2026-11-12.
